messages:
raj: seeing a 503 spike across hosted inference right after the staged rollout at ~10:05 UTC. Customers reporting API errors and timeouts. anyone oncall?

lina: I’m seeing the same in telemetry — spike in 5xx from apirouter -> backend. Starts ~10:03 and matches canary traffic window. route-tag ‘seed-42’ got way more traffic than expected.

deploy-bot: deploy started by emma at 2025-05-03T10:00:45Z. canary weight set to 50% (intended 10%) due to config apply.

emma: that’s on me — I tried to bump weight for load test but used the wrong selector in the config (used `env=staging` instead of `slice=seed-42`). didn’t realize apply validated keys. sorry.

jordan.support: multiple support tickets coming in: timeouts then retries; some customers saw billing spikes from repeated attempts. flagged high-priority.

lina: mitigation plan: 1) immediately revert canary weight to 10% 2) pin traffic to stable variant for affected routes 3) scale down canary pods to zero if errors persist.

raj: can you paste the exact rollback command so SRE can run it? want to coordinate with the k8s rollout window.

lina: rollback command (run from ops-cli):

```
ops-cli rollout set-traffic --route-tag seed-42 --percent 10 --env prod
ops-cli rollout pin-variant --route apirouter --variant stable-v3
```

I’ll also disable prefetch on the canary TTLs.

oncall: initiating rollback now and pinning stable variant. will scale canary down once weights confirmed. tagging monitoring.

deploy-bot: rollback applied by oncall at 2025-05-03T10:07:12Z. new canary weight: 10%.

emma: note to self: use `--scope=slice` when targeting seed traffic. adding a preflight validation in the PR.

jordan.support: ETA for customer impact resolution? need to update affected accounts.

oncall: errors trending down — first drop observed ~10:09. keeping watch for 15m to confirm stability.

lina: once stable for 30m we can scale canary back to 10% for validation. also creating a hotfix to prevent selector key mismatch at apply time.

raj: assigning postmortem. who’s owning?

emma: I’ll own the postmortem and include rollout preflight + config schema checks. lina, can you include the mitigation timeline and ops commands?

jordan.support: I’ll draft customer comms and coordinate refunds where retries incurred costs. :thumbsup:

oncall: all clear for now — monitoring continues. reopen thread if anything regresses.
